messages:
maria: Heads up — new cache hitmap dashboard landed in grafana: https://grafana.redwood/d/abc123/cache-hitmap-radar. It has per-model/per-route/per-tenant heatmaps and token-saved waterfall.

ajay: Nice. Any changes in keying? I noticed drop in tenant-acme's hit rate after kernel v2.4 rollout. @maria

maria: Yep saw that. Root cause looks like kernel pad-to-64 optimization changed tokenization whitespace handling causing different prefix fingerprints for some routes. Investigating.

kevin: What's the impact? token-saved delta?

maria: approx -12k tokens/min on acme-prod route, lost ~18% hit-rate for top-1k prefixes. Dashboard: model=tiny-llama route=/summarize tenant=acme

lisa: Could batching heuristics be inflating keys? We're combining inputs and adding route metadata in a different order.

ajay: I ran a profile: kernel v2.4 uses `pack_input()` that reorders attributes. Here's quick query we used in datadog:
```
sum:cache.hits{team:runtime}.as_count() by {model,route,tenant} / sum:cache.requests{team:runtime} by {model,route,tenant}
```

perf-bot: deploy v2.4 -> v2.5 rollback scheduled if hit-rate < 70% for 10m :warning:

maria: Action:
1) Reproduce locally with same tokenization setup
2) Add dashboard panel for 'key-entropy' per tenant
3) Temporary fallback to kernel v2.3 for acme-prod if regression persists.

kevin: I can add key-entropy panel. Suggest exposing `avg_key_length`, `unique_key_count`, `top-key-skew`.

lisa: Also add a column for `batch_size_distribution` — we suspect small batches cause key variance.

ajay: I'll instrument pack_input to preserve stable ordering and push a canary build to staging. Ping me if you want to test with synthetic prefixes.

maria: Test plan: run synthetic workload `tools/synth_load --tenant acme --route /summarize --seq 64 --qps 50` and compare hit-rate difference between kernels. Will post results here.

kevin: Can we add an alert: if token-saved drops >5% and hit-rate delta >10% for a tenant, page SRE?

lisa: SG. I'll add alerts with 5m window.

maria: Thanks — updating dashboard links and will post follow-up. :white_check_mark:
